process for applying for E-Waste (Management and Handling) authorization in Gujarat involves the following steps:  ##, 1. **Determine Applicability**  Identify your role in the e-waste lifecycle, such as producer, manufacturer, refurbisher, dismantler, or recycler, to understand your specific obligations under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.  ##, 2. **Prepare Required Documents**  You will need to submit the following:  1. Utilization plan for the processed e-waste  ##, 3. **Submit Application Online**  1. Access the Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP) of the Government of Gujarat. 2. Register or log in to your account. 3. Navigate to the \\'Authorization under E-Waste Management Rules\\' section. 4. Fill in the required details and upload the necessary documents. 5. Pay the applicable fees online.  ##, 4. **Obtain Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Authorization (if applicable)**  1. Producers must register on the Central Pollution Control Board\\'s (CPCB) EPR portal. 2. Provide details such as the quantity of Electrical and Electronic Equipment (EEE) placed on the market and an EPR plan outlining collection and recycling mechanisms. 3. The CPCB will assess the application, and upon approval, issue the EPR authorization.  ##, 5. **Compliance and Reporting**  1. Maintain records of e-waste collected, processed, and disposed of. 2. Submit periodic returns to the GPCB and CPCB as mandated. 3. Ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards during e-waste handling and processing. entrepreneurship. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups will be eligible for assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup during the operative period of the scheme, to enroll\\\\/participate in a national\\\\/internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Key Industry Challenges**\\\\n\\\\nThe sector continues to navigate several operational and competitive hurdles:\\\\n\\\\n- **Raw Material Price Volatility**: Unstable cotton and synthetic fiber prices impact cost management.  \\\\n- **Environmental Compliance**: Increasing regulatory costs related to water usage and effluent treatment.  \\\\n- **Labor Shortages**: Rising labor costs and a shortage of skilled workers affect productivity.  \\\\n- **Competitive Pressures**: Market saturation and global competition reduce pricing power.  \\\\n- **Energy Constraints**: Despite good infrastructure, rising energy costs and occasional disruptions challenge operations.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **5. Export Landscape**\\\\n\\\\nGujarat plays a pivotal role in India\\'s textile exports:\\\\n\\\\n- **Cotton Yarn & Fabrics**: Major exports from Surat and Ahmedabad to Bangladesh, China, and Vietnam.  \\\\n- **Synthetic & Polyester Textiles**: Significant exports include synthetic sarees, fabrics, and dress materials.  \\\\n- **Technical Textiles**: Growing exports of high-value products for medical, automotive, and defense use.  \\\\n- **Denim**: Gujarat is a leading exporter of denim fabric globally.  \\\\n- **Ready-Made Garments**: High-fashion garments from SEZs are gaining international traction.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **3. Import Dynamics**\\\\n\\\\nTo support innovation and production scalability, the industry relies on:\\\\n\\\\n- **Raw Materials**: Imports of raw silk, wool, and specialty fibers for blended fabrics and fashion apparel.  \\\\n- **Advanced Machinery**: High-tech textile equipment sourced from Italy, Germany, and Japan.  \\\\n- **Chemicals and Dyes**: Specialty finishing chemicals are regularly imported.  \\\\n- **Fashion Components**: Trims such as zippers, laces, and buttons from China and Korea.  \\\\n- **Digital Printing Equipment**: For precision printing and high-end textile design applications.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **4. Key Industry Challenges**\\\\n\\\\nThe sector continues to navigate several operational and competitive hurdles:\\\\n\\\\n- **Raw Material Price Volatility**: Unstable cotton and synthetic fiber prices impact cost management.  \\\\n- **Environmental Compliance**: Increasing regulatory costs related to water usage and effluent treatment.  \\\\n- **Labor Shortages**: Rising labor costs and a shortage of skilled workers affect productivity.  \\\\n- **Competitive Pressures**: Market saturation and global competition reduce pricing power.  \\\\n- **Energy Constraints**: Despite good infrastructure, rising energy costs and occasional disruptions challenge operations.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **5. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Startups availing benefits under other startup schemes of the Government of Gujarat are ineligible.  ##, Application Process  Online   > ***Registration Process:***  **Step 1:** Visit the online portal and click on the \\\\\"Register\\\\\" button, located at the top right corner.  **Step 2:** Enter Email ID and click on Next button. contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">SC\\\\/ST Enterprise:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> SC\\\\/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC\\\\/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><br><\\\\/p><\\\\/div>\",\"35\":\"<div class=\\\\\"ql-editor read-mode\\\\\"><p><br><\\\\/p><\\\\/div>\",\"41\":\"<div class=\\\\\"ql-editor read-mode\\\\\"><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The key objective of the Gujarat Industrial policy 2020 is to encourage R&amp;D and start innovation and entrepreneurship. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups will be eligible for assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup during the operative period of the scheme, to enroll\\\\/participate in a national\\\\/internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. It is a process of intense, rapid, and immersive education aimed at accelerating the growth of the startup.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance for Skill Development:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups shall be provided assistance for skill development training specific to soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills for the startup project. Such skill development training should support the startups in understanding the ecosystem, fundraising, commercializing, and scaling up the startup project. Financial assistance up to Rs. 1 lakh per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be given for participating in such skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to the Approved\\\\/Sanctioned Nodal Institution<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance of \\\\u20b9 1,00,000 per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be provided to Nodal institution for the mentoring service (Maximum \\\\u20b9 15,00,000 per annum per institute.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement Expenses on Organizing Promotional Events:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement of 75% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. If the event being organized is specific to \\\\\"Women Entrepreneurship\\\\\", the Nodal Institution will be eligible for reimbursement of 90% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. However, it is clarified that the beneficiary Nodal Institution will not be eligible to get assistance under any other scheme of Govt. of Gujarat for the same component\\\\/purpose.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Other Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Govt. will support approved\\\\/ sanctioned Startups to get free access to universities\\\\/ Libraries\\\\/ Govt. Laboratories\\\\/ SDCs (GIDC) \\\\/ Center of Excellence \\\\/ PSUs to support and facilitate innovative ideas\\\\/concepts.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. For organizing Acceleration Programs in Gujarat any institution, would be assisted by providing financial assistance, as approved by SLEC, maximum up to the matching contribution to the expenditure incurred.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. innovation, exports, and employment across various chemical segments.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **Dynamic Export & Import Landscape**\\\\n\\\\n**Export Highlights:**\\\\n- **Basic Organic & Inorganic Chemicals** see strong demand from Southeast Asia and Africa.\\\\n- **Specialty Chemicals** are exported for pharmaceutical, textile, and construction applications.\\\\n- **Agrochemicals & Fertilizers** make Gujarat a national leader in pesticide and fertilizer exports.\\\\n- **Dyes & Pigments**, especially vat and reactive dyes, enjoy a global market presence.\\\\n- **Petrochemical derivatives** such as ethylene and propylene are major outbound products.\\\\n\\\\n**Import Trends:**\\\\n- **Raw Chemical Intermediates** are procured for specialty and agrochemical synthesis.\\\\n- **Solvents & Reagents** serve as essential inputs across all chemical domains.\\\\n- **Lab Equipment & Analytical Instruments** support R&D and quality assurance.\\\\n- **High-Purity Chemicals** are imported for electronics and pharma applications.\\\\n- **Advanced Polymers** cater to high-performance industrial manufacturing.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **Challenges Shaping Strategic Decisions**\\\\n\\\\n- **Environmental Compliance** remains a key concern, particularly in Ankleshwar, Vapi, and Dahej, with strict norms enforced by GPCB and CPCB.\\\\n- **Hazardous Waste Management** capacity is under strain, with transportation delays and treatment bottlenecks.\\\\n- **Raw Material Price Volatility**, influenced by crude oil and forex rates, continues to affect cost structures.\\\\n- **Water Scarcity**, especially in Bharuch and Vadodara, impacts production uptime.\\\\n- **Infrastructure Stress** in industrial zones\\\\u2014congested logistics, power instability, and outdated utilities\\\\u2014reduces operational efficiency.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **Workforce Dynamics and Emerging Talent Needs**\\\\n\\\\nThe sector supports **1.2 million jobs** across direct and indirect roles.  \\\\nWhile **specialty chemicals and petrochemicals** are seeing robust hiring (**50,000\\\\u2013100,000 new skilled roles**), traditional dye and intermediate units are downsizing by up to **30%**.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **Supportive Incentive Ecosystem**\\\\n\\\\nGujarat offers a progressive subsidy framework to support sustainable chemical manufacturing:\\\\n- **50% subsidy** for CETP projects in clusters.\\\\n- **7% interest subsidy** for MSMEs.\\\\n- **Environmental compliance incentives**, including green certification and waste management tech.\\\\n- **Cluster development aid** of up to \\\\u20b95 crore for common infrastructure.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n### **Sector Growth Momentum**\\\\n\\\\nWith a remarkable **Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 46.15%**, Gujarat\\\\u2019s chemical industry is among the fastest-growing in the country\\\\u2014poised for global competitiveness through technology, policy support, and private read-mode\\\\\"><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The key objective of the Gujarat Industrial policy 2020 is to encourage R&amp;D and start innovation and entrepreneurship. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups will be eligible for assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup during the operative period of the scheme, to enroll\\\\/participate in a national\\\\/internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. It is a process of intense, rapid, and immersive education aimed at accelerating the growth of the startup.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance for Skill Development:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups shall be provided assistance for skill development training specific to soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills for the startup project. Such skill development training should support the startups in understanding the ecosystem, fundraising, commercializing, and scaling up the startup project. Financial assistance up to Rs. 1 lakh per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be given for participating in such skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to the Approved\\\\/Sanctioned Nodal Institution<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance of \\\\u20b9 1,00,000 per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be provided to Nodal institution for the mentoring service (Maximum \\\\u20b9 15,00,000 per annum per institute.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement Expenses on Organizing Promotional Events:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement of 75% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. If the event being organized is specific to \\\\\"Women Entrepreneurship\\\\\", the Nodal Institution will be eligible for reimbursement of 90% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. However, it is clarified that the beneficiary Nodal Institution will not be eligible to get assistance under any other scheme of Govt. of Gujarat for the same component\\\\/purpose.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Other Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Govt. will support approved\\\\/ sanctioned Startups to get free access to universities\\\\/ Libraries\\\\/ Govt. Laboratories\\\\/ SDCs (GIDC) \\\\/ Center of Excellence \\\\/ PSUs to support and facilitate innovative ideas\\\\/concepts.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. For organizing Acceleration Programs in Gujarat any institution, would be assisted by providing financial assistance, as approved by SLEC, maximum up to the matching contribution to the expenditure incurred.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. The project is entitled to avail of other benefits under the schemes for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Eligibility <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">For Startups:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"ordered\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Any individual\\\\/group of individuals having an innovative idea\\\\/concept and recommended by an approved Nodal Institution will be eligible to get recognized as a startup under this scheme. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"ordered\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The innovative project can be from any sector or any faculty\\\\/branch of science\\\\/ technology\\\\/ engineering\\\\/ agriculture\\\\/ healthcare and no innovation worth its name is restricted from availing assistance just because of its being in a particular sector, making this a sector agnostic scheme.<\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><br><\\\\/p><p><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note 1:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> An entity formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business shall not be considered a \\'Startup\\'.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note 2: <\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups which are availing incentives as a \\'startup\\' in any other \\'startup scheme\\' of the Government of Gujarat will not get incentives under this scheme.
